svg.title: Closed and Open Single-Well Systems
svg.desc: Closed-loop example: double-U HDPE pipes, water or antifreeze, and circulation pump. Source shallow examples: 80-150 m depth and 10-25°C ground temperature. Winter: collect ground heat and upgrade with a heat pump; summer: reject building heat to the ground. Open-loop example: pump groundwater through a plate exchanger and reinject through the same or a nearby well. Source calls for full same-aquifer reinjection. Shallow U-tube and deep fracture-enhanced systems are different technologies.
